environment.strategy: One managed backend currently serves preview and production; separate DEV/UAT/PROD environments are not evidenced in the repository.

auth.provider: Managed authentication; Android reuses the same account and session.
auth.authorization: RLS plus has_permission/has_role functions; never trust client-side roles.

storage.access: Permission-scoped private objects; signed URLs when download delivery requires it.
Server-issued signed upload token; quarantine/review workflow.

functions.description: Source-defined authenticated shared TEST projection. Requires active TEST membership; returns permission-scoped membership, department, project/record, task, approval, document-metadata, and audit data. It is not a production organization API. Deployment status must be verified per environment.

functions.name: get_project_coordination
functions.description: Authenticated read-only coordination projection for active shared TEST membership; viewers are denied. Android runtime evidence in SSM_ONE_ANDROID_BUILD_PLAN.md section 9.10 records EHW Lead/Employee reads and viewer denial on the then-current TEST backend. Returns sanitized project/lifecycle records, tasks, and linked document metadata only, not document files. This is not evidence of deployment on every environment; the Android stage overview groups only returned stage fields and explicit links, not tracks, handoffs, dependencies, or subtask hierarchies.

functions.name: mutate_shared_test_workspace
functions.description: Source-defined authenticated shared TEST mutation RPC with UUID request idempotency, stale-version checks, server-side authorization, audit writes, and scoped task, lifecycle, sample-pack, document-metadata, and approval operations. Approval requests name a reviewer department; the server validates requester authority, target department, record scope, and guards. Decisions accept approved, rejected, or returned and are re-authorized server-side. This is not a production workflow API; migration presence does not verify deployment.

functions.name: register_test_controlled_original
functions.description: Staging-only authenticated RPC added by web migration 20261106060000_register_test_controlled_original.sql. It derives organization and department from the signed-in TEST membership, checks document scope, binds immutable file metadata to a checksum and idempotency key, and returns a controlled storage path. Anonymous execution is revoked. Android uploads the selected bytes to that registered path and calls the existing byte-verification function. This is not a production contract; do not use outside the isolated TEST project without a separately reviewed deployment.

functions.name: get_customer_change_requests
functions.description: Read-only staging catalog/grant exposure is reported for isolated project jiqbxcqlywvvmhbgirzl by migration 20261101023755_customer_requirement_change_workflow.sql. The projection is intended to include project-input-linked requests, department-scoped impact rows, and requester/admin audit events. Android must not invoke until the deployed signature/decoder and role-specific authorized results/denials are verified with authenticated staging identities and a persisted web-to-mobile round trip.

functions.name: mutate_customer_change_request
functions.description: Mutation RPC is reported deployed to isolated staging project jiqbxcqlywvvmhbgirzl by migration 20261101023755_customer_requirement_change_workflow.sql, with request, return/rework, department assessment, and non-self admin decision actions; approval is intended to open the next project-input revision atomically. Android must not invoke until each server-side permission boundary, stale-version behavior, persisted audit/revision result, and cross-platform round trip are verified with authenticated staging identities.
